resolution.note: Abandoned on two independent reviews (Fable, Opus) over the shadow metrics (96-97 sessions, ~3.8k requests): cold-only clearing saves 0.5-1.5% (max 3.3%) of input cost; warm clearing breaks even after a median 40-74 turns against a median 13-22 remaining, so it costs more; main sessions use the 1h cache TTL so the proxy's 300 s cold threshold is wrong; tool_result rewriting stays a grey terms risk. Proxy stays shadow; scripts/claude/cc-clearing-watch.ts keeps watching for built-in clearing. Evidence: .krn/runs/ctx-proxy/metrics.jsonl, .krn/tmp/ctx-econ-*.py, .krn/tmp/ctxdd/sim.py.

title: Clear stale tool results in the context proxy when the cache is cold
body:
Outcome: the lead's sessions spend measurably fewer input tokens per merged PR because the localhost ctx-proxy clears stale tool results when the prompt cache is cold anyway, replacing each cleared result with a pointer to a saved copy, A/B tested on lane sessions.
Why: operator 2026-11-09 asked to never drop this idea (memory:context-clearing-pursuit). Built-in clearing is unreachable (t-mbrjeja); the proxy runs in shadow mode (t-9t45025, t-ee3y678). Terms check (.krn/runs/ctx-proxy/terms-check.md): pass-through allowed; adding context_management or rewriting tool_result is grey, so mutation waits for the operator's call.
Proof: `node scripts/claude/ctx-proxy-report.ts` on at least 10 real lead sessions shows the cold-cache would-save share; after the operator's go, an A/B over at least 30 lane sessions shows input tokens per PR before and after.
Scope: scripts/claude/ctx-proxy.ts, scripts/claude/ctx-proxy-report.ts, test/claude.
